fusions.name: Gathering Plod
fusions.desc: Shoves into the target, which deals 14 damage, knocks it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: At Your Own Pace
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered], its attacks slowed, for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Driven
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Plough Until Dusk
fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
